# RadialBarChart

**Class:** `UltraCanvasRadialBarChart` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasRadialBarChart.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasRadialBarChart.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasRadialBarChart.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Angle / radius space: polar series, radial bars, activity rings, ringed infographic

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasRadialBarChart> CreateRadialBarChart( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasRadialBarChart> CreateRadialBarChartFromSeries( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h, const std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::vector<double>>>& seriesData);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasRadialBarChart(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `SetValueFormatter()` | `void SetValueFormatter(std::function<std::string(double)> f)` | Takes a callback. |
| `SetRadialTooltipFormatter()` | `void SetRadialTooltipFormatter( std::function<std::string(const RadialBarSeries&, const RadialBarValue&)> f)` | Takes a callback. |
| `onBarClick` | `std::function<void(size_t, size_t)> onBarClick` | Callbacks receive (seriesIndex, valueIndex) |
| `onBarHover` | `std::function<void(size_t, size_t)> onBarHover` | _Bar hover_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md): `SetCustomTooltipGenerator`

### struct `RadialBarSeries`

One angular sector of the chart: a named group of consecutive bars, e.g. one sensor with its 24 hourly readings.

| `name` | `std::string name` |  |
| `color` | `Color color = Colors::Transparent` | Transparent = take from palette |
